purpose: Define and rehearse a metadata-only authenticated exception-delivery protocol for Mythical's protected company control plane. The protocol admits only changed high or critical A-015 findings, binds each alert to exact A-015 source and A-046 history evidence digests, authenticates synthetic sender and recipient acknowledgements, suppresses duplicates, exercises bounded retry and primary-to-backup failover, rejects expiry, substitution, recipient mismatch, revocation, payload leakage, false authority, and forged acknowledgement, and configures no real route, person, credential, delivery service, scheduler, or external authority.

activationGates.gate: D-017 records the operating cell, accountable alert owner, backup, urgent recipient, kill operator, and selected runtime class
Primary and backup route classes, providers, accounts, regions, recovery owners, and exact cost boundaries are selected and approved
Separated least-privilege sender, primary recipient, backup recipient, delivery auditor, and assurance identities are attested and revocable
Recipient role acceptance, on-call coverage, response objectives, absence handling, and protected recovery contacts are recorded outside the repository
Alert signing, recipient authentication, acknowledgement signing, key rotation, compromise, expiry, and revocation behavior are configured and tested
A-015 source and A-046 protected-history bindings reconcile under independently operated identities without retaining raw output
Only changed high or critical metadata is eligible and unchanged, informational, medium, resolved, duplicate, or stale state remains quiet
Payload minimization covers normal, error, retry, acknowledgement, export, recovery, and provider diagnostic paths
Durable atomic idempotency, delivery receipts, acknowledgement state, concurrent writers, replay, and retention are configured and tested
Bounded retry, backoff, rate limits, circuit breaking, quiet hours, storm suppression, and provider quota failure remain fail-closed
Primary route outage, delayed delivery, partial delivery, missing receipt, and recipient non-acknowledgement escalate visibly to an independent backup path
Backup route outage, shared failure domains, recipient recovery, route revocation, and total delivery loss exercises pass
Delivery cannot execute commands, capture approvals, mutate policy, close risks, update baselines, grant authority, or dispatch external work
Timeout, cancellation, global disable, identity revocation, and process-tree kill stop all sender, retry, backup, acknowledgement, and reconciliation work
Runtime tracing verifies only approved endpoints and zero unexpected payload, credential, subprocess, repository, command, approval, or external effects
Independent open-world evaluation covers parser differentials, oversized alerts, downgrade, denial of service, alert storms, forged receipts, and recovery abuse
Four accurate independently reviewed protected cycles deliver every eligible exception once, suppress noise, reconcile acknowledgements, and expose every failure
Separate expiring approval admits the exact identities, routes, fields, severities, retry, quiet-hours, acknowledgement, escalation, retention, and kill policies

nextDecision: Review the A-047 metadata-only authenticated exception-delivery evidence with D-017, IC-011, A-015, and A-046. Do not configure a real sender, recipient, route, credential, delivery or acknowledgement store, schedule, or network path until accountable people and independent recovery coverage are confirmed; provider, region, cost, identity, retention, quiet-hours, escalation, revocation, retry, shared-failure-domain, minimization, kill, tracing, and open-world reviews pass; four independently reviewed protected cycles reconcile; and a separate expiring exact-policy approval is recorded.
